_: The values, as data. The reasoning is in GUIDE.md; this file is the same facts in a form a build can read. Nothing here is code: a printer, a designer and a stylesheet all read the same numbers.

color._: Eight roles. Each has a day value and a night value; nothing else changes between themes. Ground and ink swap; the accents lift enough to read. Every text role passes 4.5:1 on its ground in both themes.

ground.use: Page and surface background; the tile.

sky.use: Accent; the second nibble. Links, statuses, focus.

sage.use: Marks and surfaces only. 2.9:1 on Alkali — never text.

sage-text.use: Sage where it must carry words.

geometry._: Both forms of the mark are built from these numbers and nothing else, in one unit. The bite's centre is given in the bitten cell's own coordinates.

forms._: How the numbers compose. Coordinates are derived from geometry, not stated here.

type._: Two faces on any page: Bricolage Grotesque, and one text face. The mark is all Bricolage. On a page, Bricolage takes h1 and nothing else; the text face takes everything below it. Legal and financial paper swaps Inter for Source Serif 4 below its title.

source._: Where every family's files come from: one repository, at one commit.

families._: Each family and where its files come from. Every surface serves the files itself, from type.source; nothing is fetched from a third party. None declares a Reserved Font Name, so a subset keeps its name.

markText._: Words drawn with the mark, such as the place line under a lockup.

headline._: The home page's headline: the brand's one loud line.

title._: h1 on every other page. Nothing on a page is set in Bricolage smaller than this.

text._: Everything on a page below h1. strong is for h2, h3, labels, table headers, buttons and bold lead-ins. No opsz: optical size follows the set size.

legal._: Replaces text below the title of a legal or financial document: privacy policy, terms, contracts, invoices, receipts. The test is the kind of document. A document never mixes it with text. No opsz: optical size follows the set size.

code._: Code sets in the system's monospace: the one third face a page may carry, because code is not text.

rules._: How every surface sets the faces.
rules.italic: The text face's own, for emphasis and the titles of works. Bricolage takes none.

scale._: Ratio 10/7 — cell to seam — from a 16px base.

space._: The seam unit at 4px. Every step is one of the mark's own numbers.

motion._: How the mark arrives. The sequence is derived from the name — each letter's code, most significant bit first — so only the timings are stated here.

copy._: The words the brand ships with. The voice rules that produced them are in GUIDE.md.
copy.name: snackbyte
copy.headline: Software that knows where it ends.
copy.subhead: snackbyte builds tools for people who need something that does not exist yet. Each one does one job, knows only what it needs, and stops there.

theme._: How an implementation selects between day and night.
theme.dark: prefers-color-scheme: dark, unless html[data-theme="light"]; always under html[data-theme="dark"]
